top_signals.title: Robinhood in ‘Food Fight’ for Anthropic IPO Retail Allocation
top_signals.summary: Robinhood CFO Shiv Verma said that the company is in a 'food fight' for retail access to shares in Anthropic's upcoming IPO. Verma said Robinhood is going to let its demand for shares 'speak for itself' and let trading momentum on Robinhood's platform drive the argument for access. (Source: Bloomberg)
